meta.title: Where to Eat in Hoi An, Vietnam! Best Restaurants, Coffee Shops & Desserts! Food Tour Hoi An!
meta.description:
Hoi An, Vietnam has so many delicious food options! We'll take a food tour,
showing you some of Hoi An's best restaurants, as well as its inviting Coffee Bars, and some mouth-watering desserts! We'll try a little bit of everything including a Banh Mi shop recommended by Anthony Bourdain,
the famous White Rose Dumplings, beautiful patios in both Hoi An's Ancient Town, and on its beach! If you're looking for ideas on where to eat in Hoi An, Vietnam, then this is for you!

comments.author: @Farawaynow
comments.text: This video really made me miss all that wonderful Vietnamese food. We were addicted to the coconut coffee and the Ban Mi, we usually went to their other location in the market to avoid the line.

comments.author: @TakeTimeToTravel
